name: M3_MMS200MI_UpdItmPrice
description: Update price-related information for an existing item in the item master. This operation maintains both purchase-side and sales-side values for the interface item, including unit prices, applicable quantities, currencies and several control attributes. It works on the item’s central record, not at facility or warehouse level. Use it to keep purchase price, sales price and related discount, bonus, commission and statistics controls aligned with commercial agreements, without changing technical, measurement or warehouse-specific data.

inputParameters.name: ITNO
inputParameters.description: Item number whose price data will be updated.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company in which the item's price data is updated.

inputParameters.name: ECCC
inputParameters.description: Consumption code used for trade statistics for this item.

inputParameters.name: SUNO
inputParameters.description: Main supplier number associated with the item's purchase price.

inputParameters.name: PUPR
inputParameters.description: Purchase price for the item for the stated quantity and currency.

inputParameters.name: PUCD
inputParameters.description: Quantity to which the purchase price applies.

inputParameters.name: CUCD
inputParameters.description: Currency of the purchase price.

inputParameters.name: SAPR
inputParameters.description: Sales price for the item for the stated quantity and currency.

inputParameters.name: SACD
inputParameters.description: Quantity to which the sales price applies.

inputParameters.name: CUCS
inputParameters.description: Currency of the sales price.

inputParameters.name: DIGI
inputParameters.description: Item discount group used when calculating customer order line discounts.

inputParameters.name: BGRP
inputParameters.description: Bonus group used when defining bonus item and customer agreements.

inputParameters.name: PRVG
inputParameters.description: Commission group used when defining commission and bonus agreements for the item.

inputParameters.name: FRE3
inputParameters.description: Statistics identity 3 used for accumulating item sales statistics.

inputParameters.name: FRE4
inputParameters.description: Statistics identity 4 used for accumulating item sales statistics.

inputParameters.name: OTDI
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether the item value is included in the basis for total order discounts.

inputParameters.name: BOGR
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether the item line generates or pays bonus according to bonus agreements.

inputParameters.name: PRGR
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether the item line generates or pays commission according to commission agreements.

inputParameters.name: ACHK
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether the item is included in assortment authorization checks.

inputParameters.name: BPEY
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether transactions for this item update the customer's buying pattern.

inputParameters.name: SPUC
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether the sales price unit of measure is fixed or dynamically determined.

inputParameters.name: CHNO
inputParameters.description: Change number identifying the latest change sequence for the item master, used for concurrency control during update.
